title: Amendment record for archkeel validate --against widening
$comment: Binds the recursive contract tree and canonical original before/actual after baseline policies. Legacy v1 records authorize contract-only comparisons.

before_digest.description: The --against revision's InsideContractTree.comparison_digest, binding the root and recursively mounted inside contracts. Without inside contracts this equals archkeel.ir.codec.contract_digest, SHA-256 of canonical contract_bytes. When the revision lacks the configured contract, archkeel.ir.codec.absent_contract_digest binds its repository path (AD-104).

after_digest.description: InsideContractTree.comparison_digest of the contract being validated, binding the root and recursively mounted inside contracts. Without inside contracts this equals archkeel.ir.codec.contract_digest, SHA-256 of canonical contract_bytes.

decided_by.description: Free text: who decided this widening is allowed.

rationale.description: Free text: why the widening was decided.
